name: USW-Ultra-60W
title: Switch Ultra 60W
summary: Compact 8x1GbE L2 switch, 7 PoE+ out, powered by PoE++ in or 60W/210W adapter.

extra.poe_budget_by_input: PoE++ in 42W; PoE+ in 16W; 60W PoE adapter 42W; 60W AC adapter 52W (included); 210W AC adapter 202W

gotchas: PoE budget depends on what powers it: 52W on the included 60W adapter, 42W on PoE++ input, only 16W on PoE+ — 7 ports won't all get 30W.
Needs the optional 210W adapter to approach full 7x PoE+ (202W, derated at 60°C).
All 1GbE, 1G uplink — not for WiFi 7 APs wanting 2.5G (see USW-Ultra-2.5G / Flex 2.5G PoE).
Minimal L2 feature set (no LACP/802.1X/IGMP listed) and 256 VLANs.
best_for: powering a few cameras/APs at a remote spot from one PoE++ run
not_for: high PoE draw without the 210W adapter
